comments.comment: [GOV-03] Direct-control predicate for one force record: flags_034 bit 0 selects the interactive task; zero selects the automatic task. Subordinate corps keep zero even when their root polity is player controlled.
[GOV-03] Polity-level player-control query normalizes subordinate corps through root_force_0B8 before dispatching the direct bit-0 predicate.
[GOV-03] Sets or clears player control on the root record. Clearing also writes control-order sentinel 15; selected player forces receive order values 0..N-1.
[GOV-03] The exit/control menu can hand the current root force or all selected forces to computer control, then clears the current map selection/context before returning to simulation.

[GOV-03] The world force cursor creates exactly one child per force record: direct bit-0 records use the interactive task, while subordinate delegated corps and computer-controlled roots use the automatic task.

[GOV-03] Automatic batch selection first distinguishes scenario-special, special virtual predicate, primary root and subordinate record branches; the second batch uses encoded_runtime_metadata_00C type bits, not delegation_policy_024.
[GOV-03] Work codes are attempted in table order and each non-null child is awaited before advancing, so validation and side effects of earlier shared commands are visible to later planners.
[GOV-03] Common bounded automatic-action constructor derives an attempt budget from per-code metadata, a root metadata bit and a world mode flag, then clamps it to 1..metadata maximum.
[GOV-03] Delegation policy labels are 0 general, 1 domestic focus, 2 defeat target force and 3 capture target facility; modes 2 and 3 resolve typed target references.

[GOV-03] Automatic code-12 preparation collects same-root subordinate corps, measures directly held cities and area personnel, builds governor/city groups, and sets the number of management commands to emit.
[GOV-03] Planned corps funds are apportioned by selected personnel share; food is apportioned by selected troop share, falling back to city-count share when the root troop total is zero.

[GOV-03] Emits mode-2 commands for queued subordinate corps or mode-0 commands for planned governor/city groups, then uses the same corps command constructor, validator and executor as interactive code 12.
[GOV-03] Invalid targeted delegation state is normalized atomically to policy 0 (general) and target -1.
[GOV-03] Force-pair state changes invalidate subordinate attack-force or capture-facility targets whose root relation no longer permits the target.
[GOV-03] Building deletion, vacancy or ownership invalidation clears affected capture-facility delegation targets before later automatic work runs.
[GOV-03] Alliance membership invalidates targeted delegation against an allied force and resets the subordinate corps to general delegation.
